notes: Candidate ids follow document order: migration guide top to bottom first (main source), then release-note items not covered by the guide.
mcp.types in 2.2.0 is verified against mcp_types-2.2.0/mcp_types (mcp-2.2.0/mcp/types/__init__.py:23 does 'from mcp_types import *').
snake_case field renames: one item per mcp.types class declaring camelCase fields in 1.28.1 (36 classes; the guide says all fields were renamed). RequestParams.Meta is its own item.

Distinct objects in one doc line are separate items (e.g. each removed alias, each removed lowlevel decorator, each ClientSession list method); parameters of one callable changed the same way are one item.
Change type for return/yield-shape changes is behaviour_only (the protocol's signature list does not name return types); class->type-alias changes are signature.
The v1.x maintenance releases (1.29.x, 1.30.0) are in the numeric range but their content is bug fixes or backports of 2.x changes; recorded as excluded.
